jobs.description:
**2027 Summer Internship Program**

Would you like to work for an organization committed to your professional development and personal success? John Burns Research and Consulting is an award-winning “Best Place to Work” that invests in our people through learning opportunities, professional experiences, and peer mentorship.

John Burns Research and Consulting is looking for talented students who are passionate, articulate, likable, and smart to provide the most trusted source of U.S. housing analysis and help our clients make the most informed decisions possible.

The Burns Internship provides meaningful work experiences and ongoing support and guidance to ensure you have valuable experience and prepare you for a professional career.

This Data Engineering intern will be working with our Data Engineering, Data Science and Technology groups. This is an in-person internship in our Irvine, California office.

**Program Details:**

As an **intern**, you'll begin the summer orientation delivered by experienced team members, similar to the training received by new employees. You will be working on real-time client projects, as well as a capstone project. Your capstone project will be a significant, strategic project that aligns with our real business needs and initiatives. At the end of your 10-week internship, you will do a final presentation of your capstone project, and what you learned throughout your internship.

There will be two possible start dates for our 2027 internship program:

* May 26th – August 6th
* June 16th – August 27th

(If the dates don’t work 100% for you, please still apply, and we can discuss.)

* Interns will work 40 hours per week, in our Irvine, California office.
* Salary is $25/hour.
* Positions will be posted for students to apply in October, and each position will be posted for two weeks.
  + Positions will be posted until Friday, November 6th, 2026
  + Offers will be extended by Friday, December 18th, 2026

**What you will learn:**

* Understanding our organization, industry, clients, and professional experience by working with our team members on their daily tasks.
* The opportunity to develop professional and technical skills necessary for success in the business world by working with teams within our company.

**Projects our interns may be working on:**

* Write code to fetch data from sources
* Use SQL Server and Azure Data Factory to load production-ready data
* Develop data cleaning steps in Python/Pandas
* Troubleshoot data pipelines that fail
* Reading and de-bugging existing SQL Stored Procedures
* Use Databricks to load production data and troubleshooting.

**How Do You Qualify?**

The Burns Internship Program is designed for high-performing students. We prefer candidates who meet the following criteria:

* Cumulative GPA: 3.3
* Major GPA: 3.3
* Rising seniors and graduate students (Graduating Spring 2027 – Spring 2028)
* Preferred Fields of study: computer science, statistics, mathematics, data science, or related field
* Proficiency in coding (python, pandas, SQL)
* Interest or experience in economics as pertains to the housing market
* Knowledge of building predictive models (time-series methods, machine learning methods)
* Willing to work with messy data
* Basic Excel skills
* Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage multiple tasks
* Collaborative team player
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Keen eye for details
* A strong work ethic
* A great attitude
* A willingness to learn new skills
* Exceptional time management skills to effectively prioritize tasks and meet deadlines

**To apply for the position, you must submit a cover letter and resume. Please explain why you are interested in this internship program and what you hope to gain from it.**

Join our team at John Burns Research and Consulting, LLC, a leading provider of independent subscription research and customized consulting services for the U.S. housing industry. Our founder, John Burns, started the company in 2001 with the aim of revolutionizing the housing market analysis. Today, we have a team of highly passionate research analysts and consultants nationwide who work together to provide the most trusted source of U.S. housing analysis and consulting services.

At John Burns Research and Consulting, LLC, we are proud of our award-winning culture, which includes recognition as Great Places to Work, Gallup Employee Engagement, Certified Evergreen by the Tugboat Institute, and Great Places to Work. If you want to be part of a well-established, dynamic, and high-performing team that takes it to the next level, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

jobs.description:
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.

**Job Summary**

IPAC at Caltech has an opening for an Associate Applications Developer to participate in the development of the data processing pipelines for the UVEX mission.

IPAC, part of the Physics, Math, and Astronomy Division at Caltech (www.caltech.edu), provides science operations, user support, data and archive services, and scientific vision to maximize discovery with observatories both in space and on the ground.

The Ultraviolet Explorer (UVEX) is targeted to launch in 2030 as NASA’s next Astrophysics Medium-Class Explorer mission. UVEX will undertake a synoptic survey of the entire sky in the near-UV and far-UV, probing the dynamic universe with a sensitivity more than 50 times better than GALEX. UVEX will also have a powerful broadband spectroscopic capability. UVEX will address fundamental questions from the Astro2020 Decadal Survey and study the evolution of low-metallicity, low-mass galaxies. UVEX time-domain surveys will probe the aftermaths of gravitational-wave-discovered compact object mergers, discover fast UV transients, and diagnose the early stages of explosive phenomena.

**Essential Job Duties**

As an Application Developer, you will work with the UVEX team to develop and test algorithms and write original production-quality code for pipeline processing and validation. You will also document your designs and software, and participate in meetings with the UVEX project.

**Basic Qualifications**

**If you have the following in your background, then we want to hear about your interest in joining our team:**

* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in a technical subject such as Astronomy, Physics, Math, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Sciences, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience as a software developer using Python and C/C++. In many cases, this can include experience obtained concurrent with your academic work.
* Familiarity with software configuration management principles and tools, source code version control (e.g., git/GitHub) and issue/bug tracking systems (e.g., Jira).

The following might give you a head start here, but even if these do not describe you or your experience, we would still like to hear from you:

* Advanced degree in Astronomy, Physics, Math, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Sciences, or a related field.
* Experience working with scientific datasets and use cases.
* Experience developing software for astronomical data analysis.
* Experience with the Rubin/LSST Science Pipelines software stack.

Since UVEX is a distributed collaboration, it’s important that you have good written and verbal communication skills, and are comfortable working in a distributed development environment.

**Required Documents**

* Resume
* Short Cover Letter (optional)

**Deadline and Start Date**

Applications received by November 17, 2026 will receive full consideration. The position is intended to start in 2026.  
This is an on-site position at the Caltech campus in Pasadena, California. Remote workdays are typically allowed 1-2 days per week.

Caltech is an award-winning workplace and one of the best places to work in the greater Los Angeles area. We offer an exciting and dynamic work environment, career development opportunities, competitive pay programs, great benefits, and the opportunity to participate in many campus programs and activities.

People choose to work at IPAC for many reasons, and the casual, employee-centric culture often leads to fulfilling, long-term careers and lasting relationships. We seek the best and brightest talent to join our workforce and become members of our community.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Proteus Space is a Los Angeles-based spacecraft technology company established to capitalize on a rapidly evolving space landscape and the urgent need to deliver resilient orbital capabilities to maintain and increase our national science and security interests. We combine serious space flight experience with an open minded, first-principles approach, leveraging advanced computational design and Industry 4.0 practices to deliver custom spacecraft and mission solutions with industry leading speed, precision, and reliability. We seek to enable every payload and mission with a fully custom, purpose-built spacecraft bus, designed and delivered using Proteus™, our patent-pending, automated computational design platform, with industry leading reliability.

**Role Description**

We are seeking an Embedded Flight Software Engineer with deep expertise in low-level embedded software, FPGA interfaces, drivers, and bootloader development to join our flight program team. This is a full-time, in-office role for an experienced professional with a proven track record of hands-on FSW development. In this role, you will design and implement low-level drivers, BSPs, and boot systems while managing memory architectures and FPGA hardware interfaces. You will bridge the gap between low-level hardware and high-level FSW logic, ensuring reliable spacecraft boot behavior, fail-safe recovery, and deterministic bus communications in space environments.

**Key Responsibilities**.

* Develop low-level C/C++ drivers, Board Support Packages (BSPs), and hardware interfaces for microcontrollers, FPGAs, and standard communication buses.
* Design and implement stage-1 and stage-2 bootloaders, robust boot behaviors, partition swapping logic, and fail-safe recovery modes.
* Architect memory management strategies across volatile and non-volatile memory (NOR/NAND Flash, SRAM, EEPROM) to preserve data integrity across reboots.
* Configure low-level communication protocols and bus interfaces (e.g., SPI, I2C, CAN, UART, SpaceWire, or PCIe) between compute units, peripherals, and payloads.
* Implement telemetry collection, time synchronization, and task scheduling within RTOS or embedded OS environments.
* Execute hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and debugging on flatsats using logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and FPGA emulator tools.
* Manage the codebase using modern version control systems and contribute to CI/CD workflows for automated testing and continuous integration.
* Execute comprehensive test campaigns on testbeds and flight units to verify software performance under flight-like conditions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate subsystems with the spacecraft main compute element.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
* Document design processes, test results, and system performance.
* Provide technical guidance on FSW architectures to fellow engineers, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, aerospace engineering, or similar field.
* 5+ years of embedded software engineering experience, with exposure to low-level driver development, hardware integration, or bootloaders.
* Strong proficiency in C, C++, embedded Linux, and Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS).
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and automated testing/CI workflows.
* Strong ability to collaborate effectively in a dynamic environment while maintaining a positive and professional attitude.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Must possess or be willing and eligible to obtain a United States Department of Defense Top Secret security clearance.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience writing custom drivers for FPGA logic blocks or hardware interfaces (such as I2C, CAN, SPI, UART, or SpaceWire).
* Experience with hardware-level communication protocols and hardware/software integration.
* Experience working in clean room environments and adhering to ESD protocols.
* Demonstrated experience with custom bootloader design, memory controller drivers, Flash file systems, and image verification/recovery techniques.

**Salary Range:** $130,000 - $180,000 per year. Final compensation is based on experience, education and qualifications.

**Benefits**

Proteus Space offers comprehensive benefits including paid medical healthcare for employees, flexible vacation policy, sick days, 401k matching option, pregnancy leave, family leave, holiday pay, military service leave, dental care, vision care and other benefits.

Proteus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of an applicant's age, disability, sex, race, religion, gender, national origin, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. The Company will provide reasonable accommodations to an applicant with a disability or religious belief in or to enable the applicant to apply for the position.
